name: Riptide Attack
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 215, Faiths of Balance pg. 24
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Riptide Attack (Combat)
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 215, Faiths of Balance pg. 24
You can immediately drag opponents you successfully trip.

Prerequisites: Improved DragAPG, Improved Trip, worshiper of Gozreh.

Benefit: Whenever you succeed at a trip combat maneuver, you can automatically attempt a drag combat maneuver against your tripped target as a swift action.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 25
By spending 4 stamina points, you can attempt a dragAPG combat maneuver check against any opponent that you successfully trip using Riptide Attack as a free action instead of a swift action.
